suparco_method: SUPARCO publishes no coordinates, names or outlines for its list of potentially dangerous glacial lakes (PDGL), only ID numbers, areas and a numbered dot map. SARtale georeferenced SUPARCO's 1 Jul 2026 GLOF status map (district boundaries fitted to geoBoundaries ADM2, then 7 large lakes whose areas match SUPARCO's within 10%; RMS 0.6 km), read the dot labels by eye and matched each ID to an inventory lake. 'probable': exactly one label is read at the dot, an inventory lake within 1.5 km has 0.6-1.5 times SUPARCO's area, and the district agrees where SUPARCO gives one. 'possible': the label is ambiguous or the area agrees only loosely. A dot whose label could be several IDs never gives one ID. These are reconstructions, not SUPARCO-supplied locations; no SUPARCO image or geometry is copied.
sources: HKH-PK-2020 (CC BY 4.0), Hi-MAG (CC BY 4.0), OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0); see sources.json
